newsitem.title: GERMANY: Munich Re says takes out 1.0 bln dmk loan.
newsitem.headline: Munich Re says takes out 1.0 bln dmk loan.

text.p: German reinsurer Muenchener Rueckversicherungs-Gesellschaft said on Monday it will take out a 1.0 billion mark bank loan as a complement to its capital structure.

The company said in a statement that credit rating agencies Standard & Poor's and A.M. Best had confirmed that the new loan would have no effect of Munich Re's claims-paying ability ratings of AAA, and A++ respectively.
The reinsurer said the loan would allow the firm to take advantage of the "exceptionally low interest rates currently available".
"This also creates scope for future growth," it added.
